correctness.rationale: Pointwise subspace-incidence identity holds at every alternating rank. Fourier orthogonality gives isotropic-subspace counts with exact radical lift formula. Gaussian algebra simplifies to displayed polynomial. Its evaluations at radical dimensions zero through three and positive increasing P,L for radical dimensions at least four establish one and only one negative rank orbit and no zeros for all permitted fields and dimensions. Orbit-stabilizer counts and Fourier inversion yield the exact sharp L1/L∞ convolution norm. Independent exact integer incidence-vs-polynomial checks in 42 parameter pairs and complete binary transforms at n=6,7 corroborate the universal symbolic derivation.

value.rationale: The rank-at-most-four ball is the first nontrivial secant of the Plücker rank-two cone; a natural Fourier frequency set in alternating-matrix harmonic analysis. A global unique negative shell and all-field zero-free classification, with even/odd corank jump, give an exact sharp Fourier Wiener/endpoint amplification constant and convolution invertibility. The exact global sign theorem is not a routine restatement of the known character table; it requires a nontrivial universal polynomial inequality.
